From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@webinarco.com>, On24 Support <support@on24.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Finalizing registrant field mappings + post-registration notification flows

Hi Emily / On24 team,

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. Attached is the field_mapping_sheet.csv I promised — it contains the canonical names we want in our CRM (HubSpot) and how we expect them to land from both the Zoom registration widget and On24 landing page. Two quick asks so we can lock the staging configuration: 

1) Can On24 map hidden fields (utm_source / partner_id) and forward them as tracked properties to our webhook? We want those preserved for attribution.
2) For the post-registration experience, we need two variants: immediate confirmation email (HTML partial) and a redirect to our /thank-you page which contains the session passcode. I attached post_reg_flow_v2.docx with the copy/versioning.

Also: per GDPR, we need a recording consent checkbox on the registration form with the exact language from recording-consent-text.txt — that needs to be stored as a boolean in the registrant profile.

Can you confirm what fields On24 will create by default and any limits on hidden field names or character length? If there are constraints, we can change the mapping on our side.

Next steps: if we can get a staging URL and a staging webhook endpoint before EOD Tuesday (10/12), Marissa and I will run an ingest test and confirm mapping. Tessa, please block 10/12 11:00–11:30 PT for test verification.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@webinarco.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: On24 Support <support@on24.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing registrant field mappings + post-registration notification flows

Hi Jonas — thanks for the doc and clear asks. Quick answers up-front: 

• Hidden fields: yes, On24 supports hidden fields and we can forward them to your webhook. Limit: field names must be < 64 chars and alphanumeric + underscore.
• Recording consent checkbox: we can store it as a boolean and include the field label you provided. We recommend using our standard consent label for legal tracking — but your exact text can be added as an alternate label.
• Confirmation email variants: we can support both immediate HTML email plus redirect. Note that when a redirect is enabled, some confirmation tokens are only surfaced in the URL (we can also inject the passcode into the confirmation email if you prefer).

I've asked On24 Support to provision a staging room and a webhook test endpoint for you. Support, can you open stg-8392 and provide a staging webhook (HMAC option preferred) and a mapping preview?

One more note: for HubSpot property sync, include the CRM property API name in the CSV (e.g., hubspot.contact.utm_source) so our integration preview shows exact target properties. If you can add that column, our preview will be faster.

I'll follow up with a staging URL once Support confirms.

Best,
Emily

--
Emily Zhao
Strategic Partnerships Manager, WebinarCo (On24 Partnership)
emily.zhao@webinarco.com

Thanks — mapping_preview_stg-8392.csv looks good. A couple clarifications from product/ops: 

1) HubSpot property names: I updated the CSV and re-uploaded it to the shared Drive link (see related_links). Use the hubspot.contact.* prefix for contact-level properties.
2) GDPR consent: we need the checkbox timestamp saved as an ISO string in the registrant event payload (not just a boolean). Can On24 include both consent_given (boolean) and consent_ts (ISO8601)?
3) Recording opt-in copy: we finalized the wording in recording-consent-text.txt — please use that as the stored label.

We will perform the test as planned. Tessa, I pushed the calendar invite to you and Jonas for 11:00–11:30 PT. If On24 can enable passcode-in-email for the staging redirect that would simplify the flow for registrants (fewer clicks).

-Marissa

Quick confirmation — test completed in staging at 11:00 PT this morning. Results summary: 

- 4 test registrations received. Hidden fields (utm_source / partner_id) forwarded and present in webhook payload. HMAC signature validated.
- HubSpot ingest: 3/4 mapped correctly. One property (hubspot.contact.partner_id) required manual normalization (On24 sent partner_id with leading zeros — Marissa normalized).
- Recording consent: consent_given boolean present for all; consent_ts present as ISO string for 4/4.
- Confirmation email + redirect: Passcode-in-email enabled and working. Redirect token also present in URL for mobile fallback.

Remaining item: On24 Support to confirm whether they will trim leading zeros on partner_id upstream (preferable) or if Redwood will continue handling normalization during ingest.

If On24 can confirm by EOD Monday we can flip staging -> production and open registration. Otherwise, we will document the normalization step in the runbook and proceed.

Thanks everyone — good work.

Tessa

--
